subject.title: fix(agents): strip leaked truncation sentinels from final replies (#82121)

question: Should final-reply cleanup globally remove standalone marker-shaped plaintext, or must truncation cleanup stay limited to producer/display provenance or another proven internal boundary?
rationale: The current PR chooses global final-text deletion, while related maintainer review already identified that shape as capable of deleting legitimate user-intended plaintext.

options.title: Require provenance-safe cleanup
options.body: Ask the PR to restrict removal to an internal producer/display boundary or otherwise preserve literal plaintext marker lines before merge.

options.title: Accept global sanitizer deletion
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally accept that standalone marker-shaped final reply lines can be removed from user-visible replies.

options.title: Pause for coordination
options.body: Pause this PR until the overlapping sanitizer and session-hydration work define the accepted truncation-marker boundary.

recommendation.title: Require provenance-safe cleanup
recommendation.body: Ask the PR to restrict removal to an internal producer/display boundary or otherwise preserve literal plaintext marker lines before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He already made the directly relevant boundary call on the related hydration PR and has history on the sanitizer/session surface.
